about_the_game:
Step into the mythological world of ancient Egypt in Horus: Desert Survivor, a thrilling blend of survivor-like action and deckbuilding strategy. Take on the role of Horus, battling corrupted gods, mythical beasts, and endless hordes as you seek vengeance and restore balance to your fathers land.



Face relentless waves of enemies, from corrupted deities to mythical creatures. Master your combat skills and unleash divine powers to cleanse the fallen and turn the tide in your favor. Adapt to each challenge as the hordes grow stronger with every encounter.



Build your arsenal of magical weapons through strategic deckbuilding. Combine divine artifacts, ancient weapons and training to create synergies that give you the edge in battle. Every choice shapes your journey and strengthens your ability to survive.



Forge your destiny as you navigate through ancient temples, cursed lands, and the unforgiving desert. Make impactful choices that define your playstyle, unlock new powers, and determine your ultimate fate. Will you succumb to the corruption or rise above it?
